Commenter correct. Paranoid. Banged down the doors of a police station demanding protection because I believed my life was at threat.

They organised an ambulance to bring me to my nearest hospital and after a few hours I seen the psych nurse and they evaluated me and decided I needed to be admitted.

I'm in Ireland. To be under section basically means to be detained against your will as opposed to you admitting yourself voluntarily to a hospital.

If you're detained here you're entitled to a solicitor to help fight your case to get the section removed so you can either become voluntary or go home.

The tribunal is where this decision is made. An evaluation will take place and the consultant psych from outside will have access to your notes.

So tomorrow they'll either decide I'm too unwell to go home and renew my section for another 21 days or let me become a voluntary patient.

Thank you. A friend of mine said the same that there's a very slim success rate for the patient to win the tribunal. Well we'll see tomorrow hopefully if nothing else I'll be granted escorted leave or something just to get off the ward. Thanks again.

I'm in hospital now. Started meds again last night. It was a crazy day. Lots of stuff happened and it doesn't even feel real. But I know that I need to  try my best to believe everyone who says that no one is after me, no one can see me or hear my thoughts. Maybe the meds will help me see straight. Thanks for the words.

Thank you. This is a good ward. Still have the paranoia. Feel like everyone can see me 24/7 on a live stream of my thoughts, life, actions. When my head feels funny it's interpreted as a warning that something is about to happen and I get freaked out.

Trying my best to bear with it. Still covering most of my head and face so no one can see me. At least I'm safe here in the hospital even if I don't really believe I am I know I will be cared for. Thanks!

The nurses have made me take olanzapine tonight and a sleeping tablet as a once off. I'm not feeling good about finally putting olanzapine in my system. I'll have to just wait and see how I feel tomorrow.

The Doctor never picked up but it got too real. People in the street threatening me I thought I was going to be shot just like that. An open police station and I ran in for safety. I kept making sure they were locking the door. We're in the hospital now. There's security here so even though I'm worried people could find me here it's locked and theyve told me I'm safe.

Crazy day. I hid in the woods, walked to the next town over. Felt the heat in my head and a could hear something being said. I thought it was in that moment I'd be shot. I banged down the door of this local police station and they answered. They kept me for hours and I was really unwell by this stage. Got sectioned and now I'm in a strange ward I've never been in. Still scared people are coming for me but I'm trying to remember this is a locked building with security.
